findings.title: Strict PVR boundary and complete diagnostic context

locations.excerpt: PVR ≥ 2 WU is a criteria

findings.reason: The 2024 definition uses PVR >2 WU, not ≥2. Pre-capillary PH needs the combined mPAP/PAWP/PVR definition; a number does not establish Group 1 PAH or treatment eligibility.
findings.proposed_wording: Pre-capillary PH is defined at right heart catheterisation by mPAP >20 mmHg, PAWP ≤15 mmHg and PVR >2 Wood units. Your specialist interprets these measurements with other tests to identify the cause; they should not be used to diagnose yourself or decide treatment.

findings.proposed_wording: Wedge pressure helps your team understand whether pressure from the left side of the heart contributes to PH. It is interpreted alongside pulmonary vascular resistance, imaging and your medical history; it cannot identify your PH group by itself.

findings.proposed_wording: PDE-5 inhibitors, such as sildenafil and tadalafil, help a natural blood-vessel relaxation signal last longer by reducing the breakdown of cGMP. Your specialist decides whether this medicine is suitable for your type of PH.

findings.title: Add medicine-interaction and monitoring safeguards

findings.reason: Combination therapy is not permission to combine any listed drugs. Australian CMIs explicitly warn about riociguat/PDE-5 inhibitors and nitrates; patient copy lacks medication-specific safety navigation, monitoring and missed-dose/pump advice.
findings.proposed_wording: Only take combinations prescribed by your PH team. Riociguat must not be taken with PDE-5 inhibitors such as sildenafil or tadalafil; nitrate medicines can also be unsafe with these treatments. Check your current Consumer Medicine Information and ask your PH team or pharmacist before adding any medicine, including non-prescription or herbal products. Ask for your monitoring and missed-dose plan.

findings.title: Describe BNP and NT-proBNP as related but distinct biomarkers

locations.excerpt: This is a hormone released by the heart

findings.reason: BNP is a biologically active peptide; NT-proBNP is an inactive fragment measured as a biomarker. The shared hormone description blurs that distinction. Results also need clinical context rather than implying a direct measure of how hard the heart works.
findings.proposed_wording: BNP and NT-proBNP are related blood markers that can help your team assess strain on the heart and follow changes over time. They are different tests. Your clinician interprets the result alongside symptoms, other tests and factors such as kidney function; it does not determine your outlook on its own.
